highlights: 管理台改为全宽布局，修复账号备注列错位和截断；桌面操作按钮完整显示，手机表格可局部横向滚动。
代理可直接粘贴包含用户名和密码的 HTTP、SOCKS5 或 SOCKS5h 完整链接，自动解析认证；手动认证收为可选项。
输入代理链接后即可测试连通性，无需先保存或重新打开；临时测试不会修改账号已保存的代理、健康状态或代理检测记录。
保留旧版分栏认证和已保存密码兼容，接口响应、验证错误和重新打开弹窗均不回显密码。
更新服务后请强制刷新管理页。浏览器插件仍为 1.0.2、油猴脚本仍为 1.1.2；已使用这两个版本无需重装，旧插件需在每个浏览器个人资料中手动升级。
highlights_en: Use the full viewport width in the dashboard. Fix account-note alignment and clipping, keep desktop actions visible, and contain table scrolling on phones.
Paste a full HTTP, SOCKS5 or SOCKS5h URL including credentials. Authentication is parsed automatically; manual credential fields are optional.
Test the entered proxy immediately without saving or reopening the dialog. Draft tests do not change the saved proxy, account health or saved proxy-test status.
Retain separate credential fields and saved-password compatibility. Responses, validation errors and reopened dialogs do not reveal passwords.
Hard-refresh the dashboard after updating. Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; current installations need no reinstall. Older extensions require manual updates in every browser profile.
